procedure: Compare each reported tooling-index mismatch to its current path-filtered object id and exact Git-blob bytes, while measuring checkout bytes separately.
expected: Show whether the mismatch is content drift or a checkout-versus-blob domain error.
observed: Both object ids, Git-blob byte counts, and Git-blob SHA-256 values matched exactly; only CRLF checkout bytes differed.
boundary: Bounded same-owner hash-domain witness only; the complete corrected pre-commit review remains a separate gate.
